aggregation: area-weighted mean of grid cells inside the county (0.05° resampling)
label: Total water storage anomaly (GRACE/GRACE-FO)
source: GFZ GravIS COST-G combined GRACE/GRACE-FO Level-3 TWS (DOI 10.5880/COST-G.GRAVIS_02_L3_TWS)
notes: All water on and below the land surface (surface water, soil moisture, groundwater) relative to the 2002–2020 mean. ~300 km effective resolution: neighbouring counties share most of the signal, so read it regionally (e.g. the Sudd). No data Jan–May 2018 (gap between GRACE and GRACE-FO), so the 2018 baseline is Jun–Dec only. High values in the Sudd mostly reflect flood water, not groundwater.

aggregation: area-weighted mean of grid cells inside the county (0.05° resampling)
label: Water storage uncertainty (GRACE, 1σ)
notes: One-standard-deviation uncertainty of the storage anomaly.

aggregation: area-weighted mean of grid cells inside the county (0.05° resampling)
label: Groundwater storage anomaly (G3P, from GRACE)
source: G3P v1.12 Global Gravity-based Groundwater Product, GFZ (DOI 10.5880/G3P.2024.001)
notes: GRACE total storage minus modelled soil moisture, surface water, snow and glaciers, vs the 2002–2020 mean. Ends Sep 2023 (latest G3P release). In the Sudd, errors in the surface-water term can leak into this series; treat it as indicative. No data Jan–May 2018.

aggregation: area-weighted mean of grid cells inside the county (0.05° resampling)
label: Groundwater anomaly uncertainty (G3P, 1σ)
notes: One-standard-deviation uncertainty of the groundwater anomaly.
